control_flow: avoidWalls: if the right light is below 60 %, check the wall sensors, else call driveInTheDark.
In dim light: if an obstacle is straight ahead, turn left 15°; else if an obstacle is on the left, turn right 15°; else call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is straight ahead, stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left, else curve right.
